🥂 Domino Effect
If the reader takes a sip, others may join in. Water or clapping counts too.
🎭 Masked Confession
The reader shares one surprising fact about themselves, or skips.
👑 Question King
The reader asks the group one question. Everyone may choose not to answer.
🤝 Honest Word
Everyone shares the funniest compliment they have ever received.
🔥 Awkward Choice
The reader tells a disastrous dating story or dances for ten seconds.
😈 Prime Suspect
Everyone points at whoever most often says “I am almost there” when they have not left.
💘 Secret Admirer
Everyone names a personality trait they find instantly attractive.
🎲 Power Shift
The next player reads the next normal card. The order then goes back to normal.
👀 Eye Contact
Two volunteers keep eye contact for ten seconds without laughing.
💰 Name Your Price
Everyone names a price for going on the most ridiculous date imaginable.
🎤 Improv Toast
The reader makes a ten-second toast to the strangest thing that happened tonight.
📵 Phone-Free
Anyone who wants to puts away their phone for the next three cards.
😂 Laugh Attack
Everyone tries to make the reader laugh in fifteen seconds. No touching.
🕵️ Bad Reputation
Everyone invents a ridiculous criminal nickname.
💌 Anonymous Compliment
Give anyone in the group a genuine compliment.
👄 Truth Only
The reader shares their silliest reason for turning down a date, or skips.
🤫 Secret Swap
Two volunteers share harmless secrets they rarely mention.
🎬 Sell Yourself
The reader has fifteen seconds to sell themselves as the perfect roommate.
🍹 Group Toast
Raise any drink, including water, and invent a name for tonight’s party.
🪩 Dance Break
Anyone who wants to dances for fifteen seconds. The most serious dancer wins.
🔀 Reverse
The previous player reads the next card. Then normal order resumes.
🤯 No Filter
Volunteers admit which popular trend they just do not understand.
💕 Hot Take
The reader states a controversial opinion on relationships. Everyone votes.
🎯 Future Dare
Everyone names a ridiculous challenge they might try someday, not tonight.
🫣 Red Flag
Everyone names a dating red flag they find more funny than scary.
📣 Big Announcement
The reader acts as an expert on a random topic for ten seconds.
🔔 Everyone Answers
Everyone discusses the next normal question before the reader advances.
👥 Group Secret
Everyone points at the person most likely to keep a secret.
🃏 Joker
The reader may skip the next card if it feels too personal.
🥳 Story Break
Anyone who wants to tells a ridiculous story from their last party.
🚨 Police Are Here!
Freeze like statues! The last to freeze plays a stern inspector for fifteen seconds.
⚔️ Duel!
Choose an opponent. Play rock-paper-scissors, best of three. The loser invents a silly toast.
🐀 Traitor!
Point at whoever would betray a secret for pizza. They must invent an excuse.
🔄 Royal Takeover!
Until the next card, everyone addresses the reader as “Your Majesty”.
🎭 Impostor!
The reader tells an absurd story. Everyone guesses: fact or fiction?
📱 Whisper Mode!
For one card, only whisper. Anyone who forgets declares: “I am guilty!”
👑 People’s Court!
Everyone makes up a silly charge against themselves. Vote on the funniest.
🪩 Dance Quarantine!
Everyone shows their worst dance move. Pick the most spectacular.
🕵️ Interrogation!
The reader asks a neighbor an awkward but respectful question. They may pass.
👽 Alien Visitor!
Read the next question in an alien voice, or nominate a volunteer.
